issue.title: neovim 0.1.7 freezes occasionally

repository.name: neovim
repository.description: Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability

issue.body:
- `nvim --version`: 0.1.7 and 0.1.6 installed from brew
- Vim (version: ) behaves differently?
- Operating system/version: OS X 10.12.1
- Terminal name/version: iterm2 + tmux
- `$TERM`: screen-256color

neovim will freeze occasionally (forcing a `kill -9` to regain control of the terminal). It happens quite frequently during :PlugUpdate usually around the 20ish plugin (its nondeterministic). Doing `brew switch neovim 0.1.6` and trying again with the older version and no such freeze happens.

body:
The vimrc seems long.
Can you reduce the lines?

Not really. Or yes, you can reduce the number of plugins. But as I mentioned, the more plugins you have, the higher the chance is for Neovim to hang. And with this many it's basically 100% chance. Using only a handful can also hangs Neovim, but it's not guaranteed.
And going by the last few comments in https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/5681#issuecomment-312048808, it seems like it's only macOS that's affected.

Could you try with neovim without jemalloc?
To disable jemalloc, first you need edit line 62 of formula like this:
```diff
-      system "cmake", "..", *std_cmake_args
+      system "cmake", "..", "-DENABLE_JEMALLOC=OFF", *std_cmake_args
```
Then, install neovim with `--build-from-source` option.
@equal-l2 yes, that seems to solve the issue. At least from some of my initial tests (ran `:PlugUpdate` a couple of times using my regular `.vimrc`).
I guess this is related to (or a duplicate of) https://github.com/neovim/homebrew-neovim/issues/219.

The problems indeed seems to have started with/after https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/pull/14485. In my case it happens (randomly) with/without jemalloc. 
As mentioned by @renstrom , this only seems to occur  on mac .

@petobens did you verify that it actually got built without jemalloc
(i.e. `nvim --version` returns `-jemalloc` instead of `+jemalloc`)?
@renstrom you were right. I was still getting `+jemalloc`. Will test without jemalloc and see if the freezing reappears. Thanks

issue.title: CTRL-C fails to interrupt autocmd loop

labels.name: needs:repro
labels.description: We need minimal steps to reproduce the issue

repository.name: neovim
repository.description: Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability

issue.body:
Sometimes my neovim just randomly hangs when I use mappings. Well i think it has to do with mappings but I'm not sure. So I decided to figure out how to reproduce it and it turns out it has something to do with mappings (not specific mappings, any mappings because it also has happened with other stuff). But this is how I've been able to reproduce it most of the time. It just seems to happen if I spam this mapping

```
    autocmd FileType vim nnoremap <expr> <leader>u getline('.') =~ '^\v\s*"\|^\s*$' ? '' : "I\"\<esc>j"
```

It checks if the current line is a comment or empty and if not it comments it out. So I spam it for a while and then add a number and it just magically hangs. This isn't 100% it's so random and has nothing to do with the mapping, its just magically been happening to me.

I tested on linux and OSX.

Here is a log from when I start neovim to once it hangs. It just keeps repeating those commands at the very bottom which leads to the hang. Anything else anyone needs to debug it I can likely provide. (its really long so it might take time to load)
https://gist.githubusercontent.com/nhooyr/4107226581edc8a1d38a/raw/9a88d1f1097fa756b28213166fd12a95fa68b968/log

body:
Thought I disabled jemalloc, but no. Compiling from source did it. Thanks @equal-l2.

Let you know if any freeze occurs again.
Just to add that I have been experiencing the same hanging for a good few days now when running plug update.

see https://github.com/neovim/homebrew-neovim/issues/219

@javian ~~can we pin to jemalloc 4.5 ?~~ Apparently 5.0.1  fixes it: https://github.com/jemalloc/jemalloc/issues/907#issuecomment-308724853

jemalloc 5.0.1 is in homebrew: https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/blob/master/Formula/jemalloc.rb

So, updating homebrew and rebuilding should resolve this.
